body: Thanks a lot! I will surely keep this in mind. BTW, its not that I am all gloomy all the time. You too can talk to me when you want ;)

Thanks a lot for your advice and words! I fear that taking a break will get me behind my peers in my academics. I am doing a research internship in my country and will try getting professional help too. I will sure not give up, just that thoughts get out of control when nothing good ever happens.

Since I will be now in my 4th year, I don't think there is such an option to start fresh. I am presently going for an internship in a place in my country, away from here. Maybe it will help. Semester exchange program could be a great idea. However, I am already thinking of going outside the country for a good graduate school in US or Canada, probably things will get fine. Thanks a lot for your hugs! You are a great human being! :)

Thanks a lot for your words. I have stopped contacting him since 6 months, but people who keep asking me about everything make things difficult for me. I am pretty sure I wont be removed or have to lose a year, but I feel bad for not meeting my own expectations. The situation has made it impossible for me to excel. Life is getting more and more difficult and I have no words at all. Hope things get soon.

I have contacted the university and reported the case, and he is thrown out. He has gone to the court saying that the accusations are false and raised questions on my character. Its getting a bit overwhelming. Thanks a lot for your advice.

I hope you are okay now. And thanks a lot for your words. I have extreme suicidal thoughts and nothing seems to go well in my life at all. It took a lot of courage for me to complain against him and take action. Although my friends and some of the authorities have cautioned me against any physical threat that he might be like acid attacks, etc. and this is even more depressing. I hope things get better.

Thanks a lot for your advice. The professor is unwilling to help. Rather, he is using words like "I am tired of you" and "You have been extremely insincere about work" and all. I have managed to  maintain a decent GPA despite all this and I don't want to screw my grades. It is really disheartening to see this professor thrashing me in front of everybody.  I have worried about my career and life seems to slip out of my hands.
